title: Injectivity of the matching lift
statement: For natural numbers $n,k,q$, consider tuples of $q$ subsets of an $n$-element set, each of size $k$, whose symmetric difference is empty, together with a permutation of the $k$ positions for each of the $q$ parts. The map that sends each such pair to its chosen perfect matching in the complete multipartite graph, equipped with the associated compatible vertex labeling, is injective.
